name: Thematic
oneLiner: AI feedback analytics platform that sits on top of your surveys, reviews and support data and groups open-ended comments into themes and sentiment, with a generative AI Q&A tool (Answers).
bestFor: Larger restaurant brands with insights or CX teams that already collect thousands of open-text comments and need them analyzed at scale; less suited to single locations given enterprise pricing.

updates.text: Released AI tools using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) that bring Thematic insights into Claude, ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot.

features: Connects surveys, reviews, support tickets, chat and social comments in one place
Automatic theme and sub-theme discovery without manual tagging, editable by your team
Sentiment per theme and tracking of how themes change over time
Detection of emerging or rising themes
Answers: ask questions in plain language and get summaries with charts and verbatim quotes
Filters by location, segment, period or channel, and impact on NPS/CSAT
Integrations with survey platforms (e.g. Qualtrics, QuestionPro) and SOC 2 security

pricing.text: Custom pricing; Thematic does not publish prices on its site. Third-party listings cite entry prices around $2,000/month or $25,000/year, priced by feedback volume and datasets.

notes: getthematic.com could not be fetched; search budget ran out before 2026 announcements could be checked, so only one 2025 update (from a secondary source) is included. Answers launched January 2024; QuestionPro integration November 2024; Nielsen Connect partner network membership (date not confirmed). No restaurant brand customer found; DoorDash is the closest food-related customer. Vendor-reported results (e.g. Atom Bank 69% fewer calls, 543% ROI study) are not independently verified. Third-party pricing figures conflict and are not from Thematic.
